mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_NAME, COUNT, ACTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USER_EVENTS WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT EVENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_NAME, COUNT, ACTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USER_EVENTS WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND EVENT_TYPE = #{eventType} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT EVENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_NAME, COUNT, ACTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT FROM USER_EVENTS WHERE ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND EVENT_TYPE = #{eventType} AND EVENT_NAME = #{eventName}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO USER_EVENTS ue USING ( SELECT #{accountId} AS ACCOUNT_ID, #{eventType} AS EVENT_TYPE, #{eventName} AS EVENT_NAME FROM DUAL ) src ON (ue.ACCOUNT_ID = src.ACCOUNT_ID AND ue.EVENT_TYPE = src.EVENT_TYPE AND ue.EVENT_NAME = src.EVENT_NAME) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET COUNT = NVL(#{count}, COUNT), ACTION_TYPE = NVL(#{actionType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ACTION_TYPE), DESCRIPTION = NVL(#{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, DESCRIPTION), IMAGE_URL = NVL(#{imageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, IMAGE_URL), IS_ACTIVE = NVL(#{isActive}, IS_ACTIVE), UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( EVENT_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, EVENT_TYPE, EVENT_NAME, COUNT, ACTION_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, IMAGE_URL, IS_ACTIVE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_EVENT_ID.NEXTVAL, #{accountId}, #{eventType}, #{eventName}, NVL(#{count}, 1), #{actionType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{description,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{imageUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NVL(#{isActive}, 1), SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
